subject: $urgency_emoji Overdue: your $screening_label was due on $due_date
body:
Dear $student_name,

Our records show that a health screening booked for you is now overdue. Nothing bad happens because of this — we would just like to get it done.

=== WHAT IS OUTSTANDING ===
Screening: $screening_type
Was Due: $due_date
Overdue By: $days_overdue days
Reference: $screening_id
Student ID: $student_id
Provider: $provider

$urgency_note

=== BOOKING IN ===
1. Log in to the Health Portal and choose Appointments, or
2. Call the Health Centre on (555) 123-4567, or
3. Drop in during open clinic hours.

It usually takes 15-20 minutes, and there is no charge.

=== IF OUR RECORD IS WRONG ===
If you have already had this screening — here, at your GP, or anywhere else — tell us the date and where, and we will update your record so the reminders stop. If you have decided not to have it, say so and we will record that instead.

Email health@university.edu either way, and we will sort it out.

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Health Centre: health@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Best regards,
University Health Centre

$signature
